why: Round 1 (sealed, fingerprint below) scored near chance. Diagnostics showed each bearing's own fingerprint is louder than damage. Round 2 tries features meant to cancel the fingerprint, chosen fairly.

models.lr: StandardScaler + LogisticRegression(C=1.0, class_weight='balanced', max_iter=5000), as round 1

selection: inside each outer fold: for every candidate, inner out-of-fold scores on the 5 training groups, calibrated and cut with the round-1 line rule; the candidate with the highest inner balanced accuracy is chosen; ties go to the earlier candidate. Test bearings are never used to choose.
plant_switch: the plant view uses round 2's selected detector at 16k_12b only if the lower end of its 95% range at 16k_12b is above 0.5; otherwise it stays on round 1
reported: both rounds; every candidate's own score; round 1 stays labelled as the result sealed first
